result.description: Team chat and collaboration platform from Zoho with channels, DMs, meetings, bots and a developer platform.
result.auth_detail: OAuth 2.0 only (auth-code, plus Self Client via Zoho API Console; per-DC accounts domains). Scopes like ZohoCliq.Channels.READ, ZohoCliq.Messages.CREATE. No API key.
result.access_detail: Anyone registers a client in the Zoho API Console free; Cliq has a Free plan and the pricing page lists Developer platform/API support as a feature row without plan gating on the REST API. No vendor review needed for other orgs' users to authorize an OAuth client (Zoho consent screen); Marketplace listing optional. Caveat: some admin-level endpoints need org admin, and extra features (external channels, etc.) are on paid tiers. Plan-level API limits not fully verified.
result.api_notes: REST API v2 covers channels, chats, messages, users, teams, threads, bots, calls, files, and more, with Postman collection and OpenAPI spec. Regional data-center domains required (zoho.com, .eu, .in, etc.).

evidence.quote: Zoho Cliq's Rest API's follows the OAuth 2.0 protocol to authorize and authenticate requests.
Each API must include an OAuth token in order to receive a success response.
The Cliq MCP Server exposes Cliq's core capabilities as standardized tools, so MCP-compatible AI clients can read context, take action, and coordinate work across Zoho and third-party systems.
